data.exact_reserve_text: Effective 1st January 2022, the 2019 year of account of was reinsured to close into Syndicate 3500. The reduction in Financial Investments and Cash and Gross Technical provisions during 2022, primarily reflects the impact of the successful reinsurance to close of the 2019 year of account and the continued run-off of Syndicate 2468 through 2022.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reinsurance to close of 2019 year into Syndicate 3500
prior_year_events.impact_description: Transfer of gross claims outstanding relating to 2019 & prior to Syndicate 3500, resulting in a large release of gross claims reserves.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2022 gross claims outstanding were GBP 312.493m. During 2022 the Syndicate materially reduced its gross technical provisions principally through the reinsurance-to-close of the 2019 year of account into Syndicate 3500, resulting in a gross release of c.GBP 295.7m. Smaller favourable movements in estimates and paid claims further reduced reserves to a closing gross claims outstanding of GBP 11.200m. The release was across multiple classes, notably property, general liability and marine.
raw_causal_phrases: Effective 1st January 2022, the 2019 year of account of was reinsured to close into Syndicate 3500.

The reduction in Financial Investments and Cash and Gross Technical provisions during 2022, primarily reflects the impact of the successful reinsurance to close of the 2019 year of account and the continued run-off of Syndicate 2468 through 2022.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure used is the explicit gross '2019 & Prior transfer to 3500' line (-GBP 295,729k) from the Technical Provisions reconciliation (page 27). The overall reduction in gross claims outstanding also includes smaller movements (change in estimates and paid claims) totalling the movement from opening GBP 312.493m to closing GBP 11.200m. Gross premiums written for 2022 are effectively zero per the statutory segmental table (all written amounts blank/zero). The claims development table is limited (contains only 2020) and the RITC materially distorts multi-year comparisons; therefore PYD was taken from the explicit transfer line rather than attempting triangle-derived PYD.
